authority: V8.3.193 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.192 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

The first move was easy to undo, but I stayed uncommitted by collecting more options.
The main issue needed a response, but I ignored it and shifted to an unrelated minor task.
I deliberately did not answer the central issue and distracted myself with something peripheral.
I responded later than usual, checked it once, and then left the matter alone.
